title: Tech View status pill is List's pill and is taller only at Comfortable
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-06-tech-view-compact-light-1440.png, DC-06-tech-view-regular-light-1440.png and DC-06-tech-view-comfortable-light-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • The design pictures show the status pill without the red and blue numbers; the PRD keeps List's pill with its numbers, so compare only the pill's shape and height with the pictures.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC06 Gia Pills) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC06 Status Pill") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17815) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A} and has one approved line, {Line-1} (for example "Service - Full grease service"), that is not complete and has a part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PN-DC06) requested and not yet ordered, so List shows a red and a blue number on its status pill.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter (if the Asset on Site chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click List in the display switcher.
  2. Look at {Work-order-1}'s status pill and the red and blue numbers on it.
  3. Hover the red number, then the blue number, and read each tooltip.
  4. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  5. Look at {Work-order-1}'s status pill.
  6. Hover the red number, then the blue number, and read each tooltip.
  7. Click the density button and choose Compact.
  8. Look at the status pills and compare them with the Compact design picture.
  9. Click the density button and choose Regular.
  10. Look at the status pills and compare them with the Regular design picture.
  11. Click the density button and choose Comfortable.
  12. Look at the status pills and compare them with the Comfortable design picture.
  13. Click List in the display switcher and look at {Work-order-1}'s status pill.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the pill is the same pill as in List at step 2: the same colours, the same word, the same rounded shape, with the same red and blue numbers on it.
  • Step 6: each number shows the same tooltip as in List at step 3.
  • Steps 8 and 10: the pills are the same height at Compact and at Regular (18 px in the PRD).
  • Step 12: at Comfortable the pills are visibly taller than at Regular (22 px in the PRD), as in the Comfortable picture.
  • Step 13: List's pill looks exactly as at step 2; Tech View's density did not change it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View), SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R19, S6-R2a and S6-E1, read 14 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states core__work-orders__tech-compact__light__1440, core__work-orders__tech-regular__light__1440 and core__work-orders__tech-comfortable__light__1440 (design pictures DC-06-tech-view-compact-light-1440.png, DC-06-tech-view-regular-light-1440.png, DC-06-tech-view-comfortable-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Covers the design defects SV-11318 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward). Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026.

The design draws the small pill 16 px tall, while the PRD says 18 px and calls 18 and 22 px the design's two sizes; this case follows the PRD (question PQ-V04 to the product owner, not yet answered). The tester judges only "same at Compact and Regular, taller at Comfortable".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R19: “Tech View’s Status column is the same status pill List shows in production, with the same red service-actions count and blue parts-actions count on it. Its size follows density (S6-R2a).”
  • S6-R2a: “In Tech View the status pill is 18px tall at Compact and Regular and 22px tall at Comfortable, the design’s two badge sizes. List’s status pill is unchanged.”
  • S6-E1: “Density applies to Tech View rows and Board View cards on Work Orders. List keeps today’s row size, and other application tables are unchanged.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View status badge size: “badgeSize: rowDensity === "large" ? "md" : "sm"”
